page_title: STU 3-1 BAY | Stuttgart v Bayern Munich 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Tobias Welz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Thomas Tuchel is stunned as referee Tobias Welz shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+3' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Silas (VfB Stuttgart) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Serhou Guirassy provided an assist for the goal.
90+2' Tobias Welz blows the whistle, Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch for Deniz Undav.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Manuel Neuer is prepared and dives to thwart him.
88' Half-chance! Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Alexander Nubel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 9:3.
85' The foul by Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) was seen by Tobias Welz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

83' 2 - 1 Silas produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:1.
83' Stuttgart keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
80' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
79' Substitution. Jamie Leweling makes his way off the pitch and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
78' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
78' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
77' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
75' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for holding. Tobias Welz signals a set piece.
74' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
74' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
72' Here is a change. Chris Fuhrich is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
72' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Anthony Rouault is replaced by Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart).
72' Substitution. Mathys Tel walks off the pitch and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
71' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
69' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
68' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
64' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Joshua Kimmich will be replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich).
64' That will be all from Serge Gnabry who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich).
61' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Manuel Neuer makes a simple save.
59' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Jamie Leweling, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
58' Total attempts – 17:6.
54' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayern Munich. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Flag goes up against Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) comes to nothing.
50' A snap shot by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Manuel Neuer produces a good save to thwart him.
48' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
46' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' Thomas Tuchel makes a switch. Dayot Upamecano is coming on in place of Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+3' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

45+1' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Alexander Nubel allowed him to make a comfortable save.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A rebound falls kindly for Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
45' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
44' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
43' A spell of possession for Stuttgart in an attempt to control the game.
41' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Neuer is alert to thwart the effort.
39' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
37' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexander Nubel no chance!
36' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
35' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. The referee blows his whistle and awards Bayern Munich a penalty after chaos inside the box.
35' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
34' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
33' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
33' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) jumps into a tackle and Tobias Welz signals a foul.
31' Tobias Welz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).

29' 1 - 0 Goal Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart)! Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) was put through by Deniz Undav and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 1:0.
28' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box.
26' A clumsy foul by Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) and Tobias Welz blows his whistle.
25' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
25' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to send the ball in.
25' The ball is cleared after Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
21' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
17' Thomas Tuchel is forced to make a change. Raphael Guerreiro is unable to continue due to injury, Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) comes on.
16' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' The game is interrupted now, Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

10' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Manuel Neuer thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
9' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Alexander Nubel easily deals with the threat.
8' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Some patient build-up play from Stuttgart as they look to unlock the defence.
2' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Tobias Welz will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
